verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO keys are hardware authenticators that keep credentials and biometric data on the device. They have no hosted data store where a storage region could be chosen, so region or residency selection is a category error for this product type. Evidence that biometric data never leaves the key is about on-device storage, not a residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
